integrity.claim_scope: exact all-circumference stationary counts and subsequence asymptotics, not other stationary phenomena
integrity.methods: explicit finite transfer graph, exact characteristic polynomials from integer traces, Perron inequalities, independent bounded direct enumeration
integrity.provenance: mathematical source citations and executable source included; no independent validation claimed

scientific_limitations: Only fixed configurations on labelled Moore tori with exactly three rows and at least three columns; no results on higher temporal cycles or basins.
The primary 1994 Bell text was listed at its author archive but compressed full text was not accessible; the 1988 McIntosh manuscript was assessed from the complete publisher abstract only.
No independent external mathematical validation has been performed; proof computations were internally reproduced by two standalone implementations.
title: A modulo-three resonance in fixed-state entropy: HighLife versus Life
